data.message: Dear author, since you can replace character outfits, could you also teach me how to replace a food model? Id like to replace the model of a certain food with a better-looking one. How can I do this? I dont know how to make mods or anything about modding, so Id really appreciate your guidance. Thank you!

replies.message: @asd Well, you'll want to go over RedLoader and the modding documentation from this site. You'll also need Unity, and probably UnityExplorer. You'll end up needing to write a C# plugin and make an AssetBundle for the model. As for how to do it code-wise, I'm not 100% sure. You could have it update and search for existing food models, or have a Harmony patch hooked to functions. I haven't really made an item model replacement mod yet.

@asd To replace the model once you find a food item instance, there are likely various ways to do it. I would disable the mesh renderer on the item and then add my own gameObject of my model. Experience with the Unity engine goes a long way for modding this game.
